You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. You own only: storygame/runtime/engine.py (only the method `_cue_reveal_available` and the imports it needs), tests/test_cue_spent_reveal.py (new), tests/test_cue_eligibility_compare.py and scripts/ringer/affordance/cue_eligibility_compare.py (update only as described). Edit nothing else; not data/, not storygame/story_package/, not reveal_eligibility.py. Keep storygame/runtime story-agnostic: no scene id, fact id or story name in runtime code.

PROBLEM. `RuntimeEngine._cue_reveal_available(fact_id)` in storygame/runtime/engine.py decides whether a scene cue (a one-sentence pointer such as 'A logistics computer hums by the service entrance. It may be worth reading.') may be staged. It finds the scene's reveals that assert the cue fact (or that fact's delivery cost facts) and returns True if there are none or any has all its `requires` true. It ignores whether the reveal's source storylet is already spent or the reveal already established, so the player can be invited to an action no reveal can answer any more. Storylets are optional pressure and the timer ends the scene, so this is not a blocking bug; the harm is the player is pointed at an action that gets no response. Real cases found by scripts/ringer/affordance/cue_eligibility_compare.py (read it): scene 1C after storylet SL-1C-C fired through k_sl_1c_c_r2 (cue fact national_detention_network_known); scene 2B after SL-2B-B fired through k_sl_2b_b_r3 (cue facts brandon_claimed_reform_motive, brandon_janus_role_known). Facts: 160 states had a still-missing cue fact; exactly those 3 rows are affected.

CHANGE (narrow, behaviour-preserving everywhere else). Make `_cue_reveal_available` use the shared `explain_reveal(state, audience_id, item)` (storygame/runtime/reveal_eligibility.py; import it; pass audience 'player'). A matching reveal counts as available unless its reason is STORYLET_SPENT, ALREADY_ESTABLISHED or PREREQUISITE_MISSING. Keep treating ELIGIBLE, SOURCE_INACTIVE (a storylet that has not become active yet) and NOT_VISIBLE as available, exactly as the old code did (the old code looked only at `requires`; do not start suppressing cues for not-yet-active storylets). Keep `return not reveals or any(...)`. Do not change cue staging, ranking, timing, `delivered_cue_ids`, or any other method. Read `_cue_reveal_available` and the staging code around it (engine.py around lines 395-420) first.

PROOF. (1) tests/test_cue_spent_reveal.py: keep a reference copy of the OLD `_cue_reveal_available` logic in the test. Over the real package (data/stories/continuity-initiative, loaded with `load_story_package(Path(...))`; reuse the state-building helpers of scripts/ringer/affordance/cue_eligibility_compare.py `_scene_states` etc.) compare old vs new for every scene cue delivery in every state those helpers yield: they must agree everywhere EXCEPT exactly the three real rows above (old True, new False). Assert that exact set of differences, by (scene, state label, cue fact). (2) hermetic synthetic-package tests (reuse the synthetic helper in tests/test_cue_eligibility_compare.py): a cue whose only reveal is storylet_spent is unavailable; one whose reveal is eligible stays available; one with a source-inactive reveal stays available; a cue with no matching reveal stays available; one with a missing prerequisite stays unavailable (as before). (3) A test through the real engine staging: in the 1C state above the cue fact national_detention_network_known is NOT staged any more, and in the same scene with nothing fired it still IS staged when ranked first. Find how tests/test_3c_cue_chain.py drives staging. (4) Update tests/test_cue_eligibility_compare.py and scripts/ringer/affordance/cue_eligibility_compare.py so the real report now shows 0 CUE_SHOWN_BUT_SPENT rows (the comparison calls the real engine method, so it changes on its own); the real-package test must now assert that the three former rows are AGREE (both unavailable) instead of CUE_SHOWN_BUT_SPENT, and 'Real cases observed: 0'. List every existing test you change in notes.md. The existing cue-chain tests (tests/test_3c_cue_chain.py and neighbours) must pass UNCHANGED; if one fails, stop and explain in notes.md rather than editing it.

HOW TO RUN TESTS. `uv run` does not work in this sandbox. Use `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider <files>`, after confirming `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame;print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside your working directory.
